recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5752 unless the work group separately decides that the conformance artifact root definition must duplicate the same clarification already present in the narrative.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ballot comment for FHIR-core-RiskAssessment asking that the RiskAssessment definition make clear that both structured validated-instrument risk assessments and subjective clinician or patient impressions of risk are covered.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in SVN revision 5121, represented in git as 9c2e250404bf0f52ab4a9c3e13034efa3ac3c84a ({#5752} Clarified use of RiskAssessment), which added the formal scoring/decision-support and practitioner subjective-assessment paragraph to source/riskassessment/riskassessment-introduction.xml.
additional_context: RiskAssessment remains an active current-build resource through source/fhir.ini. The current introduction still contains the FHIR-5752 clarification, and its Background and Context section also states that risk assessments can be determined manually, algorithmically, by a combination, or by decision support systems. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting or superseding evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source already conveys the requested meaning in the resource narrative, so duplicating the same wording in the StructureDefinition root definition would not change implementer understanding and could create maintenance drift.
